decision_rule: As in round 1 and R2-A. Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting to the plant through a location shared by several sites (campus rule, consultation 10), or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked before calling a JSON/JSON-LD quote missing). Confirmed = the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page of the SAME claim opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. A clause carried only by a page cited under a different claim (e.g. part_size_fit, materials, parent_company) does not confirm a single-row claim. Not additive: limiting parentheticals, technical glosses (A36 = carbon steel; Hardox = abrasion-resistant), rubric labels ('not counted', 'a delivery, not an expansion') and provenance labels naming postings that were opened today and carry the same fact. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning, or by that row's page; ends in a 'you' question; no pitch. Labor: every counted posting re-read live today on the employer's own board.

method: Scope built by script from evidence.csv: every stated row of the delegated fields for the 7 plants; every row (any tag) of each claim named after 'supporting claims:' in their score_* rows (incl. c-mellott/c-etnyre/c-schwing:multi_plant and the 5 v-mining-heavy-equipment:demand_outlook rows); the 7 opening_line rows: 138 rows, 81 distinct URLs. Every URL fetched fresh on 2026-11-16 with tools/fetch_page.fetch(with_raw=True) into the scratchpad (plain requests; headless Chromium for Paycom and the IROCK wp-json). Four ECHO records hit the 1,500/day throttle (429) and were re-read by curl after a pause. Each '...'-joined fragment matched against normalised text plus unescaped raw source: all quotes found. Then each value clause was read against its own cited page (and same-claim sibling pages). Boards: ADP job-requisitions JSON for Mellott, Derrick and Schwing (title, postDate, location), Paycom board and job pages for Etnyre (JSON-LD datePosted), company careers pages for PMI, IROCK and Supreme. Ohio Branch: PMI pages, its WordPress post/page search for 'Ohio', the Thor post. WebSearch used for discovery only (Ohio branch, West Seneca), never as a quote; the DEC 160 Empire Dr ESA (2010) was opened and is a brownfield study. No ledger file edited.
